augmentation: Detection unchanged .9..1.1 RGB brightness/contrast; segmentation .8..1.2 plus paired .75/1/1.25 scale, random crop/pad255 and horizontal flip .5. No validation geometry changes.
selection: Validation only: prefer all frozen gates qualified, then focus mIoU; if no qualified epoch, highest focus mIoU and report failure. Earliest exact tie.

detection.roi_implementation: TorchVision 0.25 deterministic eager Python ROIAlign, fixed sampling_ratio 2; no Inductor/Triton
detection.roi_determinism_note: Pinned Windows runtime reports is_compile_supported(cuda)=false and no Triton. Preserve strict determinism using the upstream differentiable implementation, not a silent CUDA nondeterministic backward. CPU values match official op; CUDA verification still required.
detection.pretrained_transfer: COCO MobileNet body and stride32 FPN projection/output; RPN convolution plus 32px ratio-specific anchor channels; new lower FPN projections and project class head seeded initialization.

segmentation.class_weights: inverse sqrt train frequency relative to max, clamp 1 to 20; zero-support classes recorded
segmentation.loss: inverse-sqrt train-frequency weighted CE plus 0.5 foreground soft Dice; ignore255 masked; absent classes excluded from per-batch Dice; annotated other0 supervised by CE
segmentation.motivation: Data-first recovery from v4 selected epoch7: same MobileUNet, mapping/loss/geometric augmentations; fine-tune frozen v4 best with main9600views plus1024 unique train-only static views repeated4times. Main dynamic samples remain70.09% of each epoch, supplement29.91%. No new dynamic episodes. 13696 sampledviews/epoch, batch8,6epochs=10272newupdates. Lower decoder LR .00015, encoder .00005 and reset optimizer/scheduler; not a strict matched-compute or data-only causal ablation. Original validation and all gates unchanged; no heldout scored.
segmentation.terrain_mapping: raw10 Terrain and raw25 Ground -> model16; raw11 Sky remains annotated other0
segmentation.visible_margin: Road/road-line side next to sidewalk or terrain/ground; predicted masks only; no occlusion completion
segmentation.capacity_evidence: mobile-sunny-capacity-001: batch8 peak allocated4055.69MiB/reserved4624MiB vs8GiB GPU, synthetic steady step~.31s; strict deterministic BF16 fwd/back/reload passed, no quality claim.

lockbox_policy: training and model selection cannot instantiate lockbox data; one explicit final evaluation after completed training
quality_gate_note: Original gates retained; additionally require precision>=0.5 per object category at the frozen score=0.5, before any new model scoring. AP alone can hide many lower-score false positives after full recall.
